name: Nigel Farage

lean.basis: Conservative Party member 1978–1992, then UKIP leader, Brexit Party co-founder and Reform UK leader. Wikipedia describes Reform as right-wing populist and far-right; it is an anti-immigration party (see source conflicts).

sources.title: Nigel Farage — Wikipedia

current_role: Leader of Reform UK; MP for Clacton (since 2024; re-elected at an August 2026 by-election)
summary: Nigel Farage led UKIP, drove the 2016 Brexit referendum, co-founded the Brexit Party (now Reform UK) and became MP for Clacton in 2024. A longtime Trump friend who spoke at Trump rallies in 2016, he spoke at NatCon in Brussels in April 2024, when police tried to shut it down mid-speech, and at NatCon Washington in 2025. In 2026 Reform added Conservative defectors including Suella Braverman; Farage resigned and won back his seat in an August 2026 by-election amid a standards inquiry into undeclared gifts.
